import sqlite3, json, time

conn = sqlite3.connect("{{db_path}}")
conn.execute(f"""
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {{table_name}} (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session TEXT, role TEXT, content TEXT, ts REAL
)
""")

def save(session: str, role: str, content: str):
    conn.execute(f"INSERT INTO {{table_name}}(session,role,content,ts) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                 (session, role, content, time.time()))
    conn.commit()

def load(session: str) -> list[dict]:
    cur = conn.execute(f"SELECT role,content FROM {{table_name}} WHERE session=? ORDER BY id", (session,))
    return [{"role": r, "content": c} for r, c in cur.fetchall()]
